analysis.reasonEn: Maintaining a 'Hold' stance for 3 consecutive days. RSI is showing signs of exiting oversold territory (29.1→30.6), but the MACD histogram is worsening (-6.2209→-8.4720), maintaining bearish convergence. Trading volume is also subdued at 0.60x the 5-day average, making directional confirmation difficult.

· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (하단 $287.81 근처) — 하단 접근, 밴드폭 43.60%로 넓음

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.60배) — 5일 평균 대비 위축, 움직임의 신뢰도 하락
· 현 구간 진단 — 축적 구간, 방향성 확인을 위한 관망 필요
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($308.85) vs SMA5 ($307.37)/SMA20 ($368.04)/SMA50 ($392.62) — Above short-term trend, below mid-to-long-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($389.83)/SMA200 ($412.22) — Below mid-to-long-term trends, maintaining bearish strength.
· 52-week position (5.7%) + Current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (29.1→30.6) — Attempting to exit oversold, weak upward momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-6.2209→-8.4720) — Bearishness persists, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Near Lower Band $287.81) — Approaching lower band, band width is wide at 43.60%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($300.41) — Located above Pivot S1 ($260.04), close to 52-week low ($297.38).
· Swing Resistance ($338.00) — Below SMA20 ($368.04) and EMA10 ($331.30).
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern — 5-day low ($297.38) is same as 20-day low ($297.38), uncertain Higher Low pattern formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.60x) — Subdued compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current Stage Diagnosis — Accumulation phase, requires observation for directional confirmation.
analysis.patternNote: 현재가 52주 저가 부근에서 횡보하며 축적 구간을 형성하고 있으나, MACD 약세 수렴과 낮은 거래량으로 인해 방향성 확인이 어렵다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The price is consolidating near the 52-week low, forming an accumulation phase, but directional confirmation is difficult due to bearish MACD convergence and low trading volume.
keyPoints: RSI는 과매도 구간에서 벗어나고 있으나, MACD 히스토그램은 악화되며 약세 수렴을 유지 중이다.
거래량 비율이 0.60으로 위축되어 있어 현재 가격 움직임의 신뢰도가 낮다.
주봉 ADX 16.2로 무추세 구간이며, 현재가(308.85)는 주봉 SMA20(385.05) 대비 -19.79% 낮아 약세가 지속되고 있다.
keyPointsEn: RSI is exiting oversold territory, but MACD histogram is worsening, maintaining bearish convergence.
The volume ratio is subdued at 0.60, indicating low confidence in current price movements.
Weekly ADX is 16.2, indicating a non-trending phase, and the current price (308.85) is -19.79% below the weekly SMA20 (385.05), showing persistent weakness.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 28.8로 뚜렷한 추세가 형성되고 있으나, -DI(38.5)가 +DI(10.9)보다 높아 하락 압력이 우세하며, 주봉 ADX 16.2는 추세가 약함을 시사한다.
analysis.riskNoteEn: ADX is 28.8, indicating a clear trend, but -DI (38.5) is higher than +DI (10.9), suggesting downward pressure is dominant, while the weekly ADX of 16.2 suggests a weak trend.
analysis.continuity: 3일 연속 관망 유지. 직전 기록과 동일하게 RSI 과매도 지속 및 MACD 약세 수렴이 관찰되며, 거래량 위축 또한 동일한 흐름을 보인다.
analysis.continuityEn: Hold stance maintained for 3 consecutive days. Similar to the previous record, RSI remains oversold and MACD shows bearish convergence, with subdued volume also following the same pattern.
